# serverkit

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/framework/internal/kit/serverkit"
```

Package serverkit is what framework/kit/server plugs into kit: the HTTP engine an app in the server profile serves on \(the SDK's server\) and the frontends' file server \(the SDK's server/static\). kit imports neither: a daemon or a CLI neither links nor initialises them.

Package serverkit — the compile\-time proof that the engine is kit's.
